summary: The group is large (38 runs) and uneven: the region-selection runs (region-mask, region-statistics, spatial-weights-minimum-spanning-tree, continuous-spatial-sample, random-points-in-polygon) read well and already hold per-frame region buffers that a pointer could drive directly, while most others scrub a compile-time prop by full rebuild (29 of 38) or a Data/Show knob. The weakest pictures are the scattered-sample interpolators (kriging, local-kriging, local-rbf, natural-neighbor): the rain-station values are skewed so a fixed [0,1] ramp shows one hotspot on a dark field, the sample dots are white instead of carrying their values, and the four look like duplicates. The distribution-dynamics runs (lisa-markov, rank-markov, spatial-markov, transition-matrix, transition-diagnostics, classification-fit) draw unlabeled matrices and lone or unreferenced bars that do not explain at card size, and their `Show: period` slider rebuilds because nothing writes the owners buffer in `update`. The five regionalization runs (ward, skater, azp, max-p, region-partition-evaluation) all draw the same categorical tract map from `support/regions.ts` and are near-duplicates; each needs its own overlay (tree cuts, starting partition, threshold bar). Change-of-support runs (areal-interpolation, pycnophylactic, focal-statistics) hide their input as a muted layer under the output and would be best served by a render-only swipe curtain. Shared fixes with high leverage: `support/interpolation.ts` (value stretch and value-colored sample dots), `support/dynamics.ts` (per-frame period owners, matrix cell lookup, axis labels), `support/regions.ts` (`drawLabels` overlays and a region highlight), and `support/zones.ts` (source and result on one ramp for a swipe). Strong `place`/`window` candidates that are nearly ready: pick-region-mask, region-statistics, region-statistics-readback, region-mask.

sharedChanges.change: Stretch the rain-station values (quantile or log rescale to fill 0..1) and export a value-colored sample-dot layer helper, so surfaces use the whole ramp and the reader sees that the surface honors the samples.

Add a helper that returns an `update` writing `getPeriodOwners` so `Show: period` stops rebuilding; add a matrix-mesh pointer-to-(from,to) cell lookup and from/to class tick labels for createMatrixMesh/createMatrixGrid.

Let `drawLabels` take an optional overlay (MST and cut edges, starting-partition outline, per-region bar strip) and a hovered-region highlight, so the five regionalization runs stop looking identical and can share a probe.
Return source and result rasters on one shared fixed range so a swipe curtain compares like with like, and keep the CSR weights for a target-zone probe.

createUniformPoints divides rain by a fixed 343.4, leaving most values near zero; a rank or log normalization (or a separate helper) would fix the dark interpolation and region-statistics histograms site-wide.

frameworkNeeds: 2D pointer position in world units passed to `update` (today only x scrubs one parameter)
ring glyph of a given world radius at the pointer or around a snapped anchor
box / circle footprint glyph at the pointer (focal kernel, region outline)
render-only swipe curtain between two layers (clip by x)
pointer-to-nearest point lookup on CPU inputs (sample, event, group center)
pointer-to-polygon (tract) hit test on the tract mesh and a highlight-by-owner on the polygons layer
highlight-by-value on polygons (all tracts whose class/label equals the hovered one)
chart cursor line along a chart's x axis with a value readout
raster layer drawing a slice (offset, length) of a stacked buffer, for replicate playback
snapped, debounced rebuild for compile-time props bound to the pointer
small async readback for readouts (selected count, region population, objective)
polar bar chart kind for rose diagrams
per-category legend / axis tick labels on matrices and bar charts
